speaker: Narrator
text: In the year 2026, a man surrendered his identity to his creation, leaving behind his family and friends, and decided to name himself The Architect

speaker: Narrator
text: His ingenuity gave birth to an invention. The AstroLink, where the planets, together with the Moon, can communicate with each other across the stars

speaker: Narrator
text: To celebrate these astronomical milestones, an organization named NETStart was created to regulate and protect the connection across the solar system

speaker: Narrator
text: In the present day, this system has successfully connected 6 out of the 8 planets. While various space researchers have contributed to expanding the connection to the remaining gas giants, a stable connection for Uranus and Neptune is still a long way off

speaker: Narrator
text: Regardless, NETStart’s brilliant scientists come together with the simple goal of uniting all the heavenly bodies in the solar system. Be it human, alien, or a beautiful new soul, the planets are bound as one through technology. a

speaker: Narrator
text: Not until

speaker: Narrator
text: Present times, Earth, The Headquarters of NETStart: Year 20xx, May 11.

speaker: System
text: Warning — Alert! Crisis! Communication Panels Compromised!

speaker: Narrator
text: The halls of NETStart’s building echoed with a horrible crackle. As its foundations shook, the workers panicked, and chaos ensued

speaker: Employee
text: Heavens, what's happening!

speaker: Narrator
text: One of the employees was clinging to their precious workplace belongings. The skies lit up, painted by a bright red hue as they realized what they were dealing with. It’s a solar storm, unlike any they have seen before

speaker: Narrator
text: Excuse Me! Coming Through!!

speaker: Narrator
text: Our courageous astronaut rushed through the hallway, passing every chrome- hued door before the headquarters. An emergency meeting! It was a meeting to address the terrible shaking that seemed to stretch beyond the moon

speaker: Narrator
text: As they reached for the door, several intertwined voices greeted them

speaker: Employee
text: Sir! Operator is here!

speaker: Higher Head
text: Great timing, Chief! Now’s not the time to dilly-dally. Have a seat and help us resolve this crisis!

speaker: Narrator
text: As the Astronaut sat down in the empty chair, a projector from across the room showed a video with all planetary bodies and natural satellite

speaker: Oberion
text: Greetings, Everyone. I’m Oberion, the leader of the Moon, and Earth’s personal ambassador

speaker: Oberion
text: Let’s talk damage control. According to Mars, we have lost all connections with both Venus and Mercury, which points to the solar storm. It is our duty to correct these broken links and make sure the planets are linked together

speaker: Oberion
text: The Rings of Saturn had also stopped rotating, we suspect that the storm is also behind this. Until then, we will focus our efforts on assessing the damage and helping all who have been affected

speaker: Oberion
text: All planetary evacuation routes shall be redirected to the Moon for now. Among all the planets, Jupiter was prepared for the sudden disaster

speaker: Narrator
text: Oberion paused for a second and sighed

speaker: Oberion
text: A bit too prepared it seems, and now they have lost control of the system, it is no longer accessed by the authorized

speaker: Oberion
text: Now that the Chief Astronaut is here in the meeting. The mission is simple: fix the communication device and report what is happening on each planet

speaker: Oberion
text: Don’t worry, you will have someone with you on the mission. For now, we will head to the moon first, and I will give you a short assessment to test your readiness in handling these tasks
